Name: 2176 Supernova Storm
Overview:
2176 Supernova Storm is a top-down space combat game that pits the player up against an invading army of cyborgs. The player takes the role of a space fighter pilot and must use the canons of his space ship to shoot down cyborgs. Power ups can be obtained from some of the cyborg ships that are shot down.

As well as a single player campaign, players can group together cooperatively to take on the single player campaign together with one other friend offline or three others online, or go head to head in multiplayer games with up to seven others locally or via Xbox Live.
